newsitem.title: USA: McLeodUSA expects merger to be approved.
newsitem.headline: McLeodUSA expects merger to be approved.

text.p: McLeodUSA Inc said Wednesday it expected to receive regulatory approval for its previously announced merger with Consolidated Communications Inc in a few months.

"Since our announcement on June 16, we have completed our due diligence review, made all regulatory filings and hope to receive regulatory approval within the next few months," Clark McLeod, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.

"In addition, early termination of the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for the merger has been granted by the Federal Trade Commission and the Department of Justice. Upon closing of the transaction, I am confident we will be in a position to begin our combined operations aggressively."

Earlier McLeodUSA, a provider of integrated telecommunications services, reported a loss of $16.5 million, or $0.31 a share, in the second quarter compared to a loss of $4.5 million, or $0.11 a share, in the same period last year.

On July 15, McLeodUSA announced the completion of a $225 million private debt offering of ten-year, 9.25 percent notes due July 15, 2007. Proceeds will be used for acquisitions, joint ventures and strategic alliances; accelerated sales and marketing activities; and development and construction of infrastructure, the company said.
